chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas gu mar gu ilkiias jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Anatot gu oidha' gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tanoolh gu Josiiyas gu mar gu Amoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook oi'ñga' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jerusalem jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bham.
Jano' ba' va'k tu' duñia' vook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k tu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Miren cham tu' ñiokda' na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu' bɨx tu' daipu' bɨx tu'.
Na gu' cham jum i'obh vupui bhaan na gu' bɨndak jix duñia' na ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu chin; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Miren gu ñi'ook gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tanoolh bhaan chɨbɨɨp bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' jix duñia' na ba' cham tu' duu na ba' jix duñia' na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu' bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jeremiiyas tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook buupui; na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gookim jix duñia' bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' gu vupui baasɨ'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' bhaan bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx ja'tkam vaak oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' aajim maa'n gu ñi'ook ba'k kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem ju'ñdharan bɨx vaak jodai bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' kuiñcha bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu noobh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook bɨx tu'; na gu' cham jum i'obh vupui bhaan na gu' cham tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tanoolh na ja'p kiicham na ja'p jix kavɨk jodai na ja'p vaak jodai jix vɨgɨ jodai bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa chiñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu' cham tu'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' jiim duuñ maatɨt gu Jerusalem bham; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch xoi'kam na pai' dhuuk tu' oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' cham.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ka't gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xixiibkam gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' bɨx; mi' dhɨr cham bhai' ɨlhdham bhaan tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Jakob bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu vaak gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook tu' tattat jix duñia' tu' jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' cham gui'p; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki pai' pai' jix gaki pai' jix gaki ɨkgiga'n koi'm pai' cham gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tu' jix daa gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Karmelo na ba' gu i'bhɨ jix bhai'; gu' ba'k gu oidha' tu' gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan cham gui'p; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios ko'kmarak ñi'ook na tu a'ga cham jix maati'; mi' dhɨr bipia'dam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' gu Baal bhaan cham.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ma'nkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kîttim gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Kedar jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook nɨidhim.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam cham gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu ja'tkam tu' gu jodai' na jix uam gɇ'kamtu'nda' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr bhaan dhi'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' suudai' buusñi gu suudai' gu tai na ba' cham gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel tu duukam ja'tkam na tu juan gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix maa gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix dhaas gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Nop gu Tapnes tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' jiim gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto na ba' i'i gu suudai' gu Nilo gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Asiria na ba' i'i gu suudai' gɨ' suudai' jiim.

Jano' ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' tu' cham bhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios choo'n tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' dɨr gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham; jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx jix bhai'x bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u tu' gu ñi'ook ganai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' bɨx; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' uañi'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Baales gu Mira jix maati' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' buur gɨ' kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki na ja'p; gio ba' bua' chɨkka bɨx cham jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr bakia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt jiim jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook; gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook nɨɨra; jano' ba' matgɨm; na gu' dha' bhaan no'ñ tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ɨxkum na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Na tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu taat tu'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai; jano' ba' tu'; na gu' suulh cham gu vupui; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu jiim tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' bamii'.
Jano' ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' gu Lebaantense tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu' bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook gu Judaa jix bɨɨx duu gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' dho'ñchidhak jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan na ja'p maavɨt.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' gu Israeel gu oidha' gu tukgam gu Por gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu'ch; jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu' gu ja'tkam tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' gu tanoolh cham namki' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr gu i'ii'ñ bia'; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' daak jix ai'chdhix tu'; na gu' tu' ba'k ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨndak na gu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gio ka' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Ejipto na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu noobh bhaan mo'o; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook cham ka't jix duñia' gu oidha' bɨx tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx mui'x; gu' tu' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui tu' pai' cham tu' cham tu'x jai'ch; na ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu Arabe oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kuiñcha gu suudai' jix duñia' dhuuk gu xumai; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu u'vɨ tu' mambhɨɨx xi'ɨraam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dɨr jano' cham duuñ tu' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ñi'ook gu Miren tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' gu Josiiyas; gio ba' buupui tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu Base bhaan bɨx gu kavɨk jix bhai'x bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr bɨx dhi'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gu' cham; jano' ba' jix ñi' gu ja'tkam gu Judaa.
Na tu' ka't buupui; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' gu Israeel tu' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' choo'n gu Judaa gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gio ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñiixim gu oidha' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu jodai bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Judaa cham tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Justipikado tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' tu' duuñ dhi' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham daak bhaan gu ñi'ook; na gu' i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam jix duñia' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Na gu' jix maati' cham gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt vaak na jix bhaan bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' tu' jix duñia' saabum; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'n kiicham gook ja'tkam vaak gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bipia'dam bhaan gu i'ii'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' ɨlhdham tu' jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨɨt gu Jerusalem gu Trono gu Jawatan Dios bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem; gio ba' tu' jiim bhaan gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Judaa gu vaak gu Israeel aajim bɨɨma'n gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tattat.

Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tu' gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu maa'nkar chugi'ñ chɨbɨɨp tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu taat mɨmɨim cham tu'.
Gu' gu' na ja'p tɨɨmo' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' duiñchu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam; gio ba' no'ch tu'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim taata'n tattat dɨr; gio ba' kakneer gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia'; na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios no'ch gu Dios tattat dɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' cham jix bhai'x na ba'.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk aa' bham gu Bibe gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx bɨx bhai'; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp tas na jix gɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook cham bhaan jo'ii'.

Jano' ba' gu Kirkunkidaos gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem; gio ba' cham ka't daak na ja'p gu tai cham ka't buimɨi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem ja'xñi; gio ba' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr ja'xñi; jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Sioon cham; na gu' tu' jix ai cham bhai' jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' maavɨt jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh ka't cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' no'ch.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu i'ii'ñ chiñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan no'm gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem bham bhai'x i'ii'ñ gui'x; na gu' tu' tɨbiap bɨɨx ka'm gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu jɨvɨl jix gaki oidha' jix gaki suudai' u'va mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam cham na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu jɨvɨl gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam ɨlhdham tu'; gio ba' jano' tu' tu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ na ja'p toov na ja'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' bɨɨx kavaayo gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; na gu' gu ñi'ook no'ch na gu' gu'ch.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem na ba' dodhia'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk kiicha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' dɨr gu Dan dɨr gu kavɨk gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' ja'xñi chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr nuuka'n jupaabkamu'n gu oidha' gu ñi'ook bhaan jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.
Na gu' na ja'p nuuka'n dɨppɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na gu' bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt buimɨi tu' jix duu dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' ba'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr cham; na gu' gu ñi'ook kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk naak gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tɨɨgim; na gu' bɨx gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr vaak zel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk no'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu ñi'ook kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.
Na gu' na gu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham jix maati' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham pui'm; mi' dhɨr mamatdagɨm na ba' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' ka't; gio ba' gu tɨkɨr cham ka't gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk bɨx jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu chio'ñ bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Karmelo oidha' jix gaki bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios i'iich gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx gu oidha' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' cham bɨx.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr jiix na gu' tu ñi'ook cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam kavaayo bɨx kiicham; gio ba' baap jix tɨ'ɨ gu jodai' na jix uam; mi' dhɨr bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix bɨɨx duu cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n oi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duu gu Bien tu' bɨɨx gu oidha' jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu vupui jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' tu' dha' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' na ja'p gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon gu ñi'ook muuk gu noobh bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jano' tu' gu i'ii'ñ kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook jano' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tu' cham tu'x jai'ch oi'ñdha' ñi'ook na jir bhai' jix duñia' tu'r; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui tu'r gu Asotaastelos cham; gio ba' cham jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu vupui gu jodai cham.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' bia' jix duñia' cham gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gio jix duñia'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki bhaan jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' no'x ka't jix duñia'; na gu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' uañchuda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook cham gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak ganai' jum daa'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p kavaayo xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu gu xibh gu u'vɨ tɨtmo.
Ba' jix aa' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan dhi' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam na ja'p cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai; gu' cham bɨx; na gu' vaak jodai na gu' cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu vaak gu Israeel gu vaak gu Judaa tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gui'p; gio ba' cham ɨlhdham cham bhai' bhaan no'ch tu' bhiogi'.
Jano' ba' va'k jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't na ja'p gu jɨvɨl cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu chin gu ñi'ook gu tai dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam nɨɨn cham tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tukga'n jix kupi'ook bɨx jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' jugi gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' jugi kakneer jugi gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk tu' cham tu'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook bɨx.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duu gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' bɨɨx no'ch bɨx dhi' tu'x jano' ba' daipu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Denunkiad dhi' gu vaak gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu Judaa bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham gu i'ii'ñ namki' gu vupui cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki' maatɨt cham.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu gɨ' suudai' baidhika' cham oo' gu ñi'ook gu' cham; mi' dhɨr gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam juraa'n gu i'ii'ñ ɨɨxi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu.

Jano' ba' cham gui'p gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu Temamos jano' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' jix maa dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' oraa' jix nukadham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' dhi' tu'x; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam.
Na gu' na gu' jix bɨɨx duu bakia' gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a na ba' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix bhuup iatda'; gio ba' jix duu chutumñigam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daam cham bhai'; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook kuiñcha ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx bɨx jix duu kuiñcha bia' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham no'ñ jix duñia' bhaan dhi' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh; gio ba' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem gu Tekoa nɨi'ñchudat kuubh bhaan gu Bet-akkêrem; na gu' tu' buupui cham bhai' jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' aajim bipia'dam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ju'ñdharan jix duñia' vaak zel; mi' dhɨr maa'n baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan; gio ba' jix búup bhaan saagi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook no'ch tu' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu xumai jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa'.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u ju'ñdharan gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr dhi' kiicham bɨx tu'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p suudai' buusñi cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu suudai' cham pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr ko'kdai'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem na gu' cham dɨlhkob gu i'ii'ñ tu' na gu' cham tu' oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' cham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ na ja'p.
Jano' ba' chɨkka no'ñ ñiokda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Miren gu ñi'ook cham jɨ'xdha' jix kai; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham.

Na ba' gu Por gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix bhuup gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan a'aalh bhaan gu masad bɨɨma'n; na gu' gu chio'ñ gio ka't kuupka' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x bɨɨx jix bhuup gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu vaak ka't bhaan dɨppɨr gio gu u'vɨ; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ' maa'n; gio ba' dɨr jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨɨx ka'm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam bɨɨx bham bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham tɨɨda' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' mambhɨɨx xi'ɨraam; na ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt chɨɨmɨlhdhapu' na ba' gu i'ii'ñ; gu' gui'p; jano' ba' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio bhaan gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gui'p; jano' ba' cham.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp jix maati' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Miren tu' cham bhai' bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam gu i'bhɨ; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n na ba' tu' dhi' kubhion gu Seba jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam gu oidha' maa'nkar tai bhaan cham aagak tu' makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Dan.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook dhi'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' dhi' gu ja'tkam tattat gu ma'nkam bɨɨma'n mia'n jix koi.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kutun kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai' gɨ' kavɨk kavaayo na ja'p gu chichio'ñ na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu noobh; gio ba' no'ch na ja'p gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' tu' jiim gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu kuchii bhaamki'ñdha' choo'n cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maatai; gio ba' na ja'p gu mar gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; na gu' jootom ɨlhdham bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bhi'ñbak; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' bɨx chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx iatda'; gio ba' jix kavɨk jodai; mi' dhɨr bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai tu'; gio ba' tu jiim tomaat cham.
Na gu' jix toja jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu Judaa dhi' kiki'ñgob na ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tutkɨ gu bhóogɨt buimɨi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' tutkɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt buimɨi; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' dhi' pai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' pai' gu oidha' tu' tattat na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ɨɨxi'ñdha' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baal jiim bhaan gu Jawatan Dios cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' dhi' gu vaak bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu'ch; na ba' gu vupui bɨx dhi'.
Jano' ba' jumpa'n ɨ'xkum vupui bhaan gu vupui dhi' gu vaak bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Miren gio tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook jano' pai' ka't gu Silo pai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Na gu' jano' na gu' jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' buimɨi tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ñiokda' cham ja'pni cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio dhi' gu vaak bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook dhi' pai' tu' gu ñi'ook tattat na ja'p gu Silo.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' soi'm tu'; na gu' cham tu' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam xoi'kam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u tattat gu tai gu u'vɨ jix duñia' na ba' duñia' gu tɨkɨr na ba' duñia' maa'nkar na jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook daak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham xoi'kam na ba' gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren i'iich daak biiñ bhaan dhi' pai' bhaan gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu vaakax bhaan gu u'u yooxi' bhaan gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu chuukug.
Na gu' na gu' cham tu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx tattat tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Gu' gu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook boopoya' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naak; gio ba' va'k gu i'ii'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bhaan cham bhaan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh tattat moor gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu duukam gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naak; gio ba' va'k jix duñia' tu' jix duu tattat.
Jano' ba' tu' daipu' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' mɨmɨim cham tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' daipu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu chin ka't.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ja'tkam daak.
Na gu' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Topet gu mar gu innom na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tai gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ tu' cham tu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu i'ii'ñ.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aajim gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu Topet tu' gu mar gu innom gu ñi'ook gu Balle gu Matansa; gio ba' ka't gu Topet cham pai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chuukug koko'kam dhi' gu ja'tkam na ba' jugi gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook saabum gu ñi'ook tɨɨmo'; na gu' gu oidha' ka't.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan o'oo gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa o'oo chiñia' o'oo jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan o'oo jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan o'oo gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem mai' pai'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas gu masad bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr tɨkka; gio ba' cham ka't tu'; mi' dhɨr ka't bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm va'k gu oidha' bɨx dhi' bɨx pai' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' daipu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham jix búup cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu tanoolh na jix bhai' iatda' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ cham bhai' bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p kavaayo bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr jix maati' gu ñi'ook namkia'; gu' gu ja'tkam cham jix maati' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' no'ch gu'ch mamatdagɨm ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' mamatdagɨm gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu ui'ka'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook matda' namki'.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ dɨppɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; na gu' dɨr bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ' maa'n dɨr jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨɨx ka'm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx xoi'kam iatda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam bɨɨx bham; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Por tɨɨda' cham jix duñia' xi'ɨraam tu' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ na pai' dhuuk; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook iigɨx jajar; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Juntaos jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook i'i na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ cham ka't xoi'kam; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Dan jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo; gio ba' jix kavɨk bɨx gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs gu oidha' kiicham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jootsa' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ko'oi bhaan cham cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' kuiñcha jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam jupaabkamu'n gu oidha'; gio ba' cham gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon cham gu gɨ'kora' gu Por gu ñi'ook jix duu bɨɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook oraa' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ux na tu ibai' gu Galaad cham cham tu'x jai'ch kako'k gu Por gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' mo'o gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gu vupui suudai' buusñi gu suudai' na ba' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' koko'kam mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook chɨkka koi oidha' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ja'tkam na gu' bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu nɨɨn na ja'p u'u gat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu'r gu oidha'; na gu' cham bhai' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n duiñchu' tu' xibhɨk jix duñia' chotdonɨt; na gu' bɨx xibhɨk bɨɨx bɨx duiñchu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duiñchu' cham tu ñi'ook tu'r; gio ba' nɨɨn ñiokda' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ iatda'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu Miren tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨɨn; gio ba' iatda' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu chin tu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham no'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan dhi' tu'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam cham gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suanda' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' oidha' jix gaki; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr dɨr gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu vaakax gu oidha' bhaan jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gɨ' kavɨk gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa cham jix duñia' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' chɨkka gu chio'ñ jix maat gu vaak na jix bhai' dhi' chɨkka gu chin gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Por kuiñcha gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' na ja'p oidha' jix gaki cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' vupui bhaan cham gu ñi'ook tu' jurtu'nka'.
Jano' ba' va'k jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu Baales tattat.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' jugi i'i gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp cham tu' tattat; gio ba' gu kuchii bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' mɨmɨim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu vupui suakɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Sioon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix duñia' baas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chin; gio ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' koi'm tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kia'mi'ñ; na ba' jix duñia' a'aalh biipibop.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ koko'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p bhaan gu vupui yooxi' na ja'p gu novɨ bhaan cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maat matda' tu' jix kavɨk tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch namkɨm.

Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bhɨɨya'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' gu oidha'; na gu' dhi' tu'x gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Ejipto gu Judaa gu Edom gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Moab bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki; na gu' bɨx chɨbɨɨp namki' jix duñia' bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel juraa'n jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt chɨbɨɨp tu' buimɨk gu tɨkɨr choo'n chɨbɨɨp.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu noobh bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu jiim na ba' cham.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham jɨ'xdha' tu jiim; mi' dhɨr cham choo'n; na gu' tu' jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook namki'.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch nɨidhim tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix gɨ' tu' jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu kavɨk.
Na gu' chɨkka cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' chɨbɨɨp na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx mamatdagɨm chɨbɨɨp bɨx gu gɨ'kora' cham cham tu'x jai'ch nɨidhim tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ jix toja jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tarsis jix uam jodai gu Upas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu noobh; mi' dhɨr ñakaabma'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu'r; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr daak gu oidha' chɨbɨɨp cham jɨ'xdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duu gu tɨkɨr tu' gu oidha' bɨtaa'n dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oidha' bɨɨx bɨxchu'x jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oipichu' bɨɨx maachim gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ tɨbaa'ñ kuugalhdha' gu oidha'; gio ba' duñia' bɨɨx dhuuk jix buusñi gu jɨvɨl gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ; gio ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨx; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu duukam tu jiim cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi.
Jano' ba' cham na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob; na gu' gu akedor bɨx tu' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga'n pai' jix kavɨk.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu jiim na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ko'kdai' dhi' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' vaak zel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba' gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu jix buusñi tu'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' vaak zel tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' bipia'dam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' cham bɨx gu vaakax gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jupaabkamu'n gu jodai' na jix uam jix gɨ' gu oidha' na ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' kakasnira' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ cham gu Jawatan gu bhóogɨt tu' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu' bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai'; na gu' cham bɨɨx i'iich na gu' cham.
Jano' ba' biiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan chɨbɨɨp cham tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam cham gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' koi'mɨk gu Jakob jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' daipu' tu'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ cham gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix kavɨk jodai tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx boopoya' gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tattat gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Pregona bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem bham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu duukam.
Na gu' na gu' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat gu tanoolh jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naak va'k jix bɨɨx duu maa'n bhaan gu i'ii'ñ; na ba' bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan cham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gaagam gu chio'ñ gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' dharka' tattat cham jix kai gu ñi'ook va'k jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu juan; gio ba' gu vaak gu Israeel gu vaak gu Judaa ñi'ook na jix bhaan ka't tu' bɨɨx tattat.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bhaan cham bhai' cham jix buus; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook tu' cham tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' na jix bhai' uuv cham gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.

Na gu' na gu' bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jɨ'dɨlh jix bɨɨx duu gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Judaa; gio ba' bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu Baal.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' soi'm; na gu' tu' cham tu jiim gu tanoolh tu' duuñ.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook juraa'n dha' gu vaak dhaibu gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mumua'da' gu chuukug jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' na gu' tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' tas na jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaas gu i'bhɨ jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu tai bhaan mamraga'n.
Na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' jix dhaas tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' bhaan tu' kuiñcha tu' na cham jir bhai' gu vaak gu Israeel gu vaak gu Judaa jix duu daak bɨɨx gu Baal.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios maachim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' ba' buimɨi.

Jano' ba' tu' na ja'p mar kaneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ux na tu ibai' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bhaan tu' bham; gio ba' gu u'u bɨɨx gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' na jix do'ig cham ka't chɨ'ñchoka' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tu'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' kuiñcha.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ gu Anatot jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ bham; gio ba' cham gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham koi gu novɨ gu noobh.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr biipibop koi; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ koi bhiogi'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' cham bhai' bhaan gu chio'ñ gu Anatot oi'ñga'.

Jano' ba' jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨndak; gio ba' tu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨndak; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x namki' xoi'kam bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu i'bhɨ; mi' dhɨr mia'n tu' gu chin gu'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maati'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' bɨndak; mi' dhɨr na ja'p kakneer na ba' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaas bɨx yooxi' gu Por tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'uvhig; na gu' gui'p; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tɨɨt tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx kavaayo tu' gu oidha' bhai'x i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu Jordaan.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu taat jix búup bhaan tu' jix maa jiiñak tu'; na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk xoi'kam tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar dhagia' dha'da' gu i'ii'ñ gu noobh obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't na ba' tu' gu maa'nkar na ja'p maavɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhaan tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook; na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu u'uvhig mui'x jix uam cham bhaan gu u'uvhig gu Benid bɨx gu vaakax yooxi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mui'x bipia'dam jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va gu maa'nkar oidha' jix gaki gu maa'nkar dha'ram.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'; na gu' ka't bɨx gu oidha' na gu' cham ka't gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki tɨɨtɨs; na gu' gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm; mi' dhɨr cham bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' matgɨm gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tiriik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jo'ii'; gio ba' chooto'n gu maa'nkar gu' cham cham tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu i'bhɨ kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx tomaat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Miren tu' gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook maa'n gu maa'nkar gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam na ba' ñi'ook kavɨk aa' gu tɨɨgɨ' bham gu Bibe gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk aa' gu Baal; gio ba' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ja'tkam tatk jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook cham gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gookim jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook bamii' tu' gu Euprates gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan gu Euprates na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'x gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bamii' tu' gu Euprates jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Euprates gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook pai' ka't gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't; na ba' matgɨm ka't jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam cham bhai' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu juan na ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' ɨlhdham na ja'p dhi' gu ñi'ook na ba' matgɨm jix bhai'.

Na gu' na gu' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tu' bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel bɨx gu vaak gu Judaa tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bhaai'n gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bhai' ñi'ook nɨidhat; gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' daipu' dhi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va bɨx; jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' cham bɨx suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' a'ga; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhuup bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n dhi' gu oidha' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan atooxkor jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n bɨɨx tattat bɨɨx gu ma'nkam bɨɨma'n tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham tu' jix duñia' tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' cham cham tu' duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' cham; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios va'k gu tukgam va'k tɨɨt gu kakkavɨk gu tukgam gu tasi' ɨkgiga'n koi'm gu tukgam.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ɨxchuixim gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ kuiñcha; na gu' joi'ndam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vupui suakɨt na gu' kakneer gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu oidha'; na gu' kuruun gɇ'kamtu'nda' ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh saagi'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't; gio ba' bɨx gu Judaa ka't bhaan ka't bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui jupaabkamu'n; gio ba' duukat kakneer tu' ka't jix maa gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gɇ'kamtu'nda'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook daipu' na pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' mo'o bhaan tu'; gio ba' cham tu' na ja'p gu u'vɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' daam dhi' gu Por gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' jix bɨɨx duu dha'npak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tuk gio gu ñi'ook kua' gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu jɨvɨl oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' duñiixim bhaan; gio ba' yooxi' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jerusalem cham ka' bɨɨx ka'm duuk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jeremiiyas bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa kiki'ñgob; gio ba' gu oidha' jix tɨ'ɨ tu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai'; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr suulh bɨɨx jix bhai'x; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu jiim ɨɨbhidham.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' kuiñcha cham; gio ba' uubas tu jiim ɨɨbhidham.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook na gu' cham ka't gu vaas.
Jano' ba' buur gu kakkavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jɨvɨl na ja'p; na gu' gu vupui na gu' cham ka't gu vaas.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan no'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook nɨɨra gu Israeel gu Guardador gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duñia' gu oidha' na ja'p na ba' mambhɨɨx gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu chio'ñ na ja'p jix kavɨk cham jɨ'xdha' tu' cham gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan no'ch gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' cham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' tɨɨt; na ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham juraa'n aagak; jano' ba' jano' tu' na cham jir bhai' jix duñia' uañi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam na ba' xoi'kam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham tu jiim tu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar cham; gio ba' va'k bɨɨx bhiogi' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham chɨgia' tu' bhiogi' gu ñi'ook dhi' pai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ɨɨxi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook iatda' gu i'ii'ñ.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' cham jix duñia' gu Kukillo tu' bhiogi' cham dhi' gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨɨx bhiogi' ka't jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baas ka't gu Jerusalem bhiogi' gu kuchii; gio ba' cham gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; mi' dhɨr bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' a'ga dhi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui suakɨt gu tukaa' gu tanoolh cham; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' koko'kam; gio ba' tu' kiicham kako'kkam bhiogi'; na gu' gio jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan na ja'p jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oidha' cham jix maati'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu Judaa tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu Sioon gu Por gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Esperamos bhai'x i'ii'ñ cham ka't xoi'kam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook taata'n tattat; na gu' bhaan tu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu tɨɨgɨ' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan atooxkor gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' cham ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx no'ch.

Jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maat gu tɨkɨr gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu'; na gu' tu' bɨx dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu Diijome gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Moisees gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' aagak cham ka't bɨɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daipu'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na koi'm; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr bhiogi'; jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan maakobh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ba' kooda' gagai' na ba' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha' na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duu kapbhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' kuiñcha gu Manasees gu mar gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Na gu' na gu' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem chɨkka kuiñcha chɨkka tu' tu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'; na ba' tu' bhaan tu' gu novɨ tu'; mi' dhɨr dhi' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm kiki'ñgob gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo' gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh bhaan gu naan gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr bhaan kiicham jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv; gio ba' jix bhuup gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu tas jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh; jano' ba' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' kapbhai' vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu naan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu vaak na jix bhai' gu chio'ñ bɨx gu oidha' cham pai' dhuuk tu'; gio ba' bɨx jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tɨɨda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' bhaamki'ñdha' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jodai baasɨ'n jix vɨgɨ jodai.
Jano' ba' namkɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham u'uuk bɨx uañi'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' cham jix maati'; na gu' gu tai tu' jix duñia' i'iich bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr cham jix bhɨɨ; jano' ba' ñɨidhat xoi'kam tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't bhai' ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chu'p tu' kuiñcha ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan; na gu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't cham gu ñi'ook ka' na ba' tu' na ja'p gu suudai' cham dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' vupui bhaan tu' dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix buusñi gu ñi'ook ka' na ja'p gu chin; jano' ba' tu' cham tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam jix kavɨk vaak jodai jix vɨgɨ jodai bhaan tu' cham tu'; na gu' tu' dhi' bɨndak na ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu novɨ tomaat tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' tu' gu u'vɨ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ dhi' pai'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' pai' naana'n tattat dhi' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' na jix uam dudua'ñ koi'm; gio ba' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; mi' dhɨr ka't bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'; jano' ba' bɨɨx bhiogi' ka't gu chuukug ka't na ba' jugi gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tu' jix duu tu'; na gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' koi dhi' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim gu takarui' na ba' gu ñi'ook koko'kam; gio ba' tu' i'i vaaso gu ñi'ook gu taat gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu vaak na ba' bɨɨx jugi i'i.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' pai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu tanoolh bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook saabum bɨx gu ñi'ook tɨɨmo'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨx dhi' tu'x tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan no'ch bɨx dhi' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ chulhiiñdha' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daipu'; na gu' tattat gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' cham nukadham ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat; na gu' gu ñi'ook maa'n bhaan gu i'ii'ñ cham tu'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' gu oidha' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' tattat jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu tukaa'; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx oi'ñga'n pai' ka't; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' tu' tattat.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jootsa' mui'x bhibhiadam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi' dhɨr mui'x gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨx gu kavɨk bɨx gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu jodai' na jix uam.
Na gu' na gu' gu vupui bhaan bɨx gu bhóogɨt cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ñi'ook gu vupui.
Gu' gu' maa'n namkidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ; na gu' gu oidha' bɨɨx gu chuukug koko'kam jix bhuup gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' aajim chɨbɨɨp dɨr gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook taata'n tattat gu ñi'ook cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu' cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu kavɨk gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' uañi'ñ gu Judaa ua'nak bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jodai bɨɨx jodai na jix kavɨk; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ju'ñdharan gu u'u jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' bɨx uañi'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu maa'nkar tu' tu juan obhɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' cham; na gu' gu tai jix duñia' i'iich na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix dhaas gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki cham na pai' dhuuk daraibu' xoi'kam; gu' gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios chotdonɨt gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na gu' ka't na ja'p gu u'u gu ux na tu ibai' ju'ñdharan gu suudai' ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham na pai' dhuuk daraibu' jix tónom gu ñi'ook jajar jix duñia' gu vaas; gio ba' oi'ñga' cham tu' kiicha' duñia' gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu'x jix bhai'x; gio ba' chɨkka jix maati'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios kutun kavɨk gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' maa'n bhaan gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu i'bhɨ buimɨi.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham jix dhaas namkɨm cham bɨɨx bɨx bhai'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh kiicha' ka't.
Jano' ba' atooxkor gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam pai' chulhiiñdha' xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios nɨɨra gu Israeel bɨx tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' tu' jix bhai'x ka't oo'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia'; na gu' tu' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' duukat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jano'.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bipia'dam tu' gu tanoolh tu' ñɨidhat; gio ba' gu chin tu' gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' nɨɨra tu' gu tanoolh cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu'; gio ba' tu' cham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bhaan gu tanoolh cham bhai' bɨɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam ba'k gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu Judaa bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem dhi' kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kɇkɇɇda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh juanda' na ba' kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tanoolh juanda' tu' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu tanoolh juanda' na ja'p tattat.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naak va'k jix duñia' cham tu' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' ka't cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob dhi' kiicham gu tanoolh juanda' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh juanda' cham bhaan matgɨm gu ñi'ook.

Na jɨjɨkgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob dhi' kiicham jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii chiñia' gu chio'ñ gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem; gio ba' dhi' kiicham ka't na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' aajim jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa xikoolh gu Jerusalem gu oidha' gu Benjamiin vaak ja'tkam gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar tu' kubhion jix duñia' gu maa'nkar bhai' ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix bhaan gu tanoolh juanda' na ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem gu tanoolh juanda' tu' jix duu gu tai kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' vaaso jix duñia' bhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; gio ba' tu' jix duu vaaso bhaan tutkɨ duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' duñia' gu ñi'ook na ja'p dhi' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Miren na ja'p bhi'ñ gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook bhaan chɨbɨɨp bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' jix duñia' cham tu' duu.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' tu ñi'ook tu' cham bhai' ka't duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' tu' jix duñia' cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui cham tɨiñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't gu tanoolh na jix bhai' duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham bhai' bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jano' maa'n cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt tutkɨ gu bhóogɨt buimɨi.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' duñia' maa'n gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jano' chɨbɨɨp chɨkka jix duñia' ka't naak; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jabook gu Liibano gu jodai yooxi' gu suudai'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ja'tkam tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt cham.
Na ba' na ba' jix dhaas gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook mo'o.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu jɨvɨl gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan bhaamki'ñdha'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu vupui gu tanoolh jai'chdhɨlhia'.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jeremiiyas; na gu' ñi'ook na tu a'ga cham jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' jix bhai'x tu' gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' nɨɨn cham bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' cham bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Akueerdate vupui bhaan tu' na ba' ñiokda' xoi'kam na ba' daak.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kapbhai' gu ma'nkam bhiogi' tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kuchii; gio ba' gu u'vɨ cham gu ma'nkam dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm; mi' dhɨr bɨpna' ka't koi'm bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu vaak na pai' dhuuk bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix bhai'x; na gu' na ba' tɨɨt jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam.

Gu' gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maati' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' na ba' koi'm; gio ba' cham tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' uañi'ñ vupui bhaan gu vupui; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan tu'; jano' ba' gu vupui bɨɨx gu ñi'ook i'iich.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨndak daraa gu ja'tkam daraa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu innom ba'k ki'ñgob gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham bhai' bhaan dhi' pai' jix duñia' maatɨt.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' pai' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tattat tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix bhuup dhi' pai' gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu Baal na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tai gu ma'nkam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Baal; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' tu ñi'ook tu' suudai' u'va.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' pai' cham tɨɨt gu Topet tu' gu Balle gu mar gu innom gu ñi'ook gu Balle gu Matansa.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem dhi' pai'; gio ba' vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu noobh jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug na ba' jugi gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kiicham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu chuukug ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' maa'n jugi gu chuukug jix duñia' bɨɨx obhɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui gu chio'ñ bɨndak.

Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam dhi' kiicham na ja'p vaaso bhi'ñ cham jɨ'xdha'; na gu' gu Topet na gu' cham pai' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' pai' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n dhi' kiicham na ja'p gu Topet.

Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't na ja'p pai' gu Topet jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaak bhaan bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeremiiyas gu Topet pai' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Miren tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan dhi' kiicham bhaan bɨx cham bhai' tu ñi'ook bhaan; na gu' jix duñia' na ba' cham gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Pasur jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu mar gu Immer gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu Jeremiiyas jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Pasur gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin jix bhai'x gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Pasur jix buusñi gu Jeremiiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Pasur gu ñi'ook gu Magor-missabib.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx xoi'kam tu' obhɨɨ'ñ gu vupui; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Judaa kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaan gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' kiicham bɨx tu jiim bɨx tu'x a'bhar; gio ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu noobh obhɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Pasur bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k gu Babiloonia koi ka' tu' bɨx xoi'kam tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix kavɨk tu'; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia'; jano' ba' tu'.
Na gu' na gu' dɨr chɨɨdaim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiiñak gu ñi'ook gu Biolenkia chajaañ; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' na ba' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'; gu' cham gu ñi'ook ka't gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p gu tai o'oo tu jiim cham.
Na gu' na gu' tu' vaak jodai mui'x choo'n bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr bɨx tu'; jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook; na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham; na gu' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a na gu' cham; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam mɨɨjidha' ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai' ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ tu'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu i'ii'ñ gampai' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Maldito gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu naan cham ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix maa jix duñia' gu taat bham gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' maaxir jix duñia' jix jai'.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu chio'ñ na ja'p jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham; gio ba' gu xibh jiiñak tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vook gu naan jix duñia' tukga'n vook.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vook na ba' tu jiim gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas bhañ gu Pasur gu mar gu Malkîas gu Sepaniias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu mar gu Maasiias tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu ñi'ook no'ch gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch bhaan bɨx kɨɨ'p bhaan no'ch.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sedekîas.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham gu noobh bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; mi' dhɨr gu Kaldeos namki' mia'n mai' vaak jodai tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu novɨ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk bɨɨx i'iich tu' daak jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n dhi' kiicham; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax koi gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam kiicham gu ñi'ook bhiogi' gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr cham uañi'ñka' tu' makia' tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt koi'm.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kiicham koi bhiogi' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Kaldeos namki' mia'n ii'mdagaram gu oidha' ka't.
Na gu' na gu' gu vupui gu ñi'ook bhaan dhi' kiicham na ba' cham bhai' cham na ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't kapbhai' gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa daipu'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu vaak gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu novɨ; na gu' daak cham na ja'p gu tai cham ka't gu ñi'ook buimɨi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr chɨkka bhaan no'ch chɨkka gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' gu i'bhɨ buimɨi tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu tai bɨx xikoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa daakat bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii tu' gu ja'tkam ba'k dhi' kiki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' gu novɨ cham tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' gu ɨ'ɨr dhi' pai'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Dabii bhaan atooxkor jɨjɨkgɨm gɨ' kavɨk jix duñia' kiki'ñgob dhi' gu vaak gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu vaak ka't oidha' jix gaki.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' tu' mo'o gu Liibano; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tɨɨda' tu' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu tai.
Jano' ba' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan dhi' kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n duiñchu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx dhi' jix gɨ' kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi tu'; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu'; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook mɨɨjidha' tu' gu oidha' pai' gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sallum gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josiiyas gu taat jix buus dhi' pai'; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' va'k koi pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan cham dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak cham bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ñi'ook na jir bhai' tɨtmo cham tu jiim.
Na tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' gu vaak gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' tu' gɨ' u'u kavɨk cham jix jugi jix i'i gu taat tu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' jano' ba' ka't xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jano' ba' juruuñ xoi'kam; gio ba' cham dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu vupui gu i'ii'ñ cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook duñia'.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' cham bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' bham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gɨ'x bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' mai' kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Liibano duuñ gu Basaan jix maa gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx; na gu' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu jiim; jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu bhóogɨt dɨr gu ñi'ook cham pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx bipia'dam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jɨvɨl; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu' kuiñcha bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Liibano gu ñi'ook gɨ' u'u kavɨk; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk tu' na ja'p gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Koniias gu mar gu Joakiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jum duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ kɨɨ'n tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu novɨ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam ñiata gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu novɨ gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu naan tu' gu oidha' cham; gio ba' koi.
