Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu chio'ñ gu Koniias gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaaso bɨɨx soo'mchulhdhak gu Por gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu oidha' cham.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't dhi' gu chio'ñ cham tu' bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'; na gu' gu chio'ñ gu kai' bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii bhaan gu Judaa ka't mɨɨjidha' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bipia'dam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bipia'dam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kakneer cham jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook buimɨi tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer bɨx oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix mui'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bipia'dam; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu ñi'ook jir bhai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ka't jix duñia' gu Judaa tu' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai' gu Nuestra.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' gu vaak gu Israeel gu oidha' bɨx oi'ñga'n ka't tu' baas; mi' dhɨr jix daa gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' kuiñcha jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bɨx o'oo jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu chio'ñ na ja'p gu chio'ñ suudai' u'va vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' na gu' gu oidha' jix bhuup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu oidha' pai' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr pai' jix gaki; jano' ba' ka't gu kavɨk cham tu jiim.
Na gu' na gu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan na ja'p jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vaak gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu tukgam ka't gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't; na gu' tu' cham bhai' bhaan oi'ñga' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Samaria buupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Baal tu' jix duu gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jerusalem buupui gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' jix duñia' jiim gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu noobh tomaat na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu bɨx na ja'p gu Sodoma gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu Gomorra.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bhaan mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' tu' jugi i'i gu suudai'; na gu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jerusalem jix buus bhaan bɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ cham gu chin gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ gui'x; jano' ba' no'x jiim bhaan gu i'ii'ñ gui'p; gio ba' cham ɨlhdham cham bhai' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' chɨkka juruuñ ɨxchuixim gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' jix kai gu ñi'ook chɨkka juruuñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix kai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx i'iich; gio ba' bhaan mo'o tomaat.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm ka't jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' kuugalhdha' gu tanoolh kaaya'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' tu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' cham tu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ɨxchuixim gio gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook buimɨi.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu Jawatan Dios jix jai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' naak mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gui'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk ka't dhi' gu i'ii'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook iatda' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p xoi'kam gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx tɨɨtki' maa'n jix duñia' duiñchu' tattat gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Baal.

Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨɨx ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' bɨɨx ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook juraa'n bɨɨx tiriik tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook maa'n mia'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ñiiñio'k; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Miren tu' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtki' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' jix duu gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' tu' cham jix duñia' tu'; mi' dhɨr jix duu dhi' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios daipu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam sɨlhka'n bhaan jix duñia' gu chio'ñ bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duiñchu' xibhɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨlhdham chɨ'ñchoka'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ñi'ook maa'n ka't gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' daipu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Karga gu Jawatan Dios dhaibu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga; gio ba' cham gu Karga gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kiicham tu' gu ñi'ook tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook baidhika' gu jodai' na jix uam cham pai' dhuuk.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gook gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr bhaan gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Jekôniias gu mar gu Joakim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa chiñia' gu Judaa gu Jerusalem jix duñia' baabuk gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix bhai' na ja'p; gio ba' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tomaat cham jugi tomaat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jeremiiyas tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'; jano' ba' tomaat gu bhóogɨt tomaat cham jɨ'xdha' jugi.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p dhi' ja'tkam jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Judaa dhi' pai' gu oidha' gu Kaldeos na ba' xoi'kam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui bhaan na ba' xoi'kam dhi' gu oidha'; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr gu ux na tu ibai' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tomaat gu ñi'ook tomaat cham jɨ'xdha' jugi tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa chiñia' gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook dhi' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n daa'ñchu'nda' mu'ai bɨx pai' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu kuchii bhiogi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' tu' tattat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Judaa oi'ñga' maakobh gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa oi'ñga' maa'n gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Judaa bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem bham.
Jano' ba' dɨr oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josiiyas gu mar gu Amoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook jix maa aa'ñdham; gu' cham.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' cham tu' naak na ba' jix kai.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jano' cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook buimɨi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tattat na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' daak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; gio ba' cham cham bhai'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' naak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh na ba' cham bhai'.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' cham jix duñia' naak gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Miren gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia tu duukam bhaan dhi' gu oidha' bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n bhaan bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨroon gu tasi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' gu oidha' ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu juan dhi' chɨbɨɨp gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaan mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu oidha' gu Kaldeos; gio ba' oidha' jix gaki na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mii' dhɨr gu oidha' bɨx gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bhaan bɨɨx bɨx ua'nak dhi' u'uan gu Jeremiiyas bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Na gu' na gu' tu juan gio mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' namkidha' jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ vaaso suudai' u'va dhi' i'iich jix maa i'i bɨx chɨbɨɨp tu' jootsa'.
Jano' ba' i'i gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' jootsa' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaaso gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios tu' i'i bɨx chɨbɨɨp bhañ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jerusalem jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' na ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mu'ai na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto tu duukam chiñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' gu us bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' gu Palestina gu Askaloon gu Gasa gu Ekroon gu Asdod.
Jano' ba' gu Edom gu Moab gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Sidoon gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Dedaan gu Tema gu Bus bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oipichu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Arabia bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Simri bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Elam bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Media.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mia'n bɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Sesak i'i mi' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' bɨɨpɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jootsa' tu' bhaan bhiogi' gu ñi'ook na ja'p tomaat gu ñi'ook tomaat cham jɨ'xdha' jugi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu kuchii bɨɨx bhiogi' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' mu'ai gu ñi'ook bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tɨip; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhaan gu Jerusalem gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Akâb gu mar gu Koliias gu ñi'ook gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Maasiias gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu Miren kapbhai' tu' gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' bɨx bhaan gu Judaa gu Babiloonia jix bhɨɨ mu'ai bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Sedekîas na ja'p gu Akâb gu tai gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.

Na gu' na gu' jix duu tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Israeel jix duñia' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook cham; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' ñi'ookdham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Semaiias gu Neelam tu ñi'ook bham.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem gu Soponiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu mar gu Maasiias bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook tu jiim jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan pai' gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham jano' gu Jeremiiyas gu Anatot jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhañ a'ga gu Babiloonia; gio ba' jix bhai'x tu'; mi' dhɨr gu vaak; jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Soponiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't jiñkai'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga bɨx; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semaiias gu Neelam; na gu' jix duñia' gu Semaiias tu' cham jix duñia' jix duu jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren tu' bhaan gu Semaiias gu Neelam bhaan; mi' dhɨr cham gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' mii' dhɨr xoi'kam tu' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uan bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu Judaa tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oidha' tu' tattat gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Judaa.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ; na gu' buupui bɨx gu chio'ñ ga'ra' gu noobh bhaan gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu u'vɨ jix duñia' bɨx gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham cham tu'x jai'ch nɨidhim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Jakob; gu' ka't.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baakux cham juantu'n.
Gu' gu ñi'ook tu juan gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' tu' tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob cham jum i'obh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Israeel; na gu' tu' jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' gu kai' gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu Jakob cham.

Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' dodhia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chɨbɨɨp tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu ñi'ook cham bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai' cham tu' bɨx.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha na ba' tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; gio ba' cham tu' jix duñia'; na gu' bhaamki'ñdha' tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kuiñcha tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu Desaukiado; na gu' gu ñi'ook mui'x uañi'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu'; gio ba' bɨx; mi' dhɨr ka't tu' bɨx jix duu tu'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Arrojada tu' tɨɨt bham; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Sioon soo'mchulhdhak tu jiim.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x vaak zel gu Jakob vaak zel xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; mi' dhɨr kiicham ka't bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan ka't bhaan duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam xoi'kam; gio ba' cham ka't; mi' dhɨr cham ka't.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ma'nkam na ja'p maa'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' mia'n tu'; na gu' chɨkka mii' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ na ba' jix duñia' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' boopoya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx i'iich; gio ba' bhaan mo'o jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh kaaya' dhi'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu Israeel ka't tu' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' oidha' jix gaki gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiimchu' tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix jai' gu ñi'ook tu' bham; gio ba' bɨɨx xoi'kam tu' dha'; na ba' tu' bɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' ka' jix duñia' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va gu kakkavɨk gu Samaria; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' jix duu kua'dam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook nuuka'n gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' jix búup gu Sioon gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook jiiñak gu ñi'ook mo'o chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr ja'xñi; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dodhia' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñiññia mama'mkulhi' gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam bɨɨma'n; gio ba' jix gɨ' chu'p jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx suanda' gu' bɨɨx i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam jiim ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; na gu' jix duñia' gu Israeel gu taat gu Epraim maa'nkam mar.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim ja'xñi; na tu jiim gu Israeel nukadham na ja'p bipia'dam gu vaakax.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim gu Jakob tu jiim gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' aajim jix duu bhai' ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu Sioon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu vaakax kakneer; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't na ja'p u'uu pai' tu' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' kɨklhi'ñga'n bɨɨma'n; gio ba' suanda'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x jix bhai' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ramaa gu ñi'ook suanda' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; na gu' gu Rakêl gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam cham gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam na gu'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vupui suakɨt; na gu' cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' nɨɨra gio cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak gu Epraim; gio ba' jix duñia' na ja'p; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tɨtdaidha' mi' dhɨr; na gu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a na gu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu Epraim gu mar gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ba'k; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' buimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt pai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel dhi' jɨ'dɨlh.
Na gu' bɨɨx ka'm duuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Judaa jɨ'dɨlh na pai' dhuuk tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gio bɨx jɨ'dɨlh uubas bɨɨx kakneer.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Israeel gu vaak gu Judaa gu kai' gu chio'ñ gu kai' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tattat koi'mɨk taatam gu ma'nkam namki'.
Gu' gu ñi'ook koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' taatam bɨx gu chio'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix vɨɨk ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu vaak gu Jakob bɨɨx gu vaak gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' cham na ja'p ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tattat gu tanoolh gu novɨ na ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na gu' ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam jix duñia' tu' gu chio'ñ na ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu vaak gu Israeel mi' dhɨr mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga ba'k ua'na'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtmo tu' xibhɨk bham; gio ba' jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bɨx jix maati' dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' na cham jir bhai' cham uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tas na ba' gu tasi' gu tanoolh ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu masad gu si'avag na ba' gu tasi' gu tukaa'; na baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' tu' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios vupui bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gio gu kai' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' cham gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan tu' bɨx gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tɨkɨr jiix jɨ'xdha' jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gio tu' bɨx gu kai' gu Israeel bɨx jix duu tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kiicham ka't gu Jawatan Dios dɨr bhi'ñbak gu ananeel bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan bhaan gu areb gu ñi'ook gu Goa.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug koko'kam maatai bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm jix duu gu Kedroon bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob kavaayo tas buusñi ka't jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham ka't tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu Nabukodonosor.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ga'ra' mia'n gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jeremiiyas ka't kuupka' naadat kuupa' ka't gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na gu' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't kuupka' bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' bham; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kapbhai' dhi' kiicham gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa cham gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Kaldeos gu ñi'ook tɨɨda' ka't dhagia' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chin gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sedekîas gu Babiloonia bɨɨx ka'm tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx gu Kaldeos cham xoi'kam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu' bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu anameel gu mar gu Sallum jupaabkamu'n tu' bham; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu Anatot; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va tu' gu anameel gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naadat kuupa'; na gu' jano' gu maa'nkar gu Anatot gu oidha' gu Benjamiin na gu' gu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr na ba' tu'; jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu anameel gu mar ka't gu Anatot tuumiñ; gio ba' jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' ua'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tuumiñ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan jix kupi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias gu mar gu Maasiias vupui bhaan gu anameel gu mar vupui bhaan jix daa gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan bɨx gu Judiios mi'p naadat kuupa'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baruk vupui bhaan bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook jix kupi'ook vaaso bhi'ñ na ba' jix duñia' mui'x gu tanoolh.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak dɨppɨr oidha' u'va dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' cham tu'x jai'ch cham tu' ka't na ba' tu'.
Na duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' tattat baaso gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu vupui bhaan bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ na ba' maa'n bhaan gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu i'bhɨ buimɨi.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨk gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx buimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu oidha' tattat gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' baap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' ñi'ook na tu a'ga; mi' dhɨr cham tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook; na ba' gu ñi'ook jix ai bhaan bɨx dhi' cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix duñia' kiicham na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' kiicham tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Kaldeos bhaan kuiñcha gu kuchii bhiogi' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' tɨbiap tu' tu ñi'ook tu' ñɨi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar tuumiñ; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam kiicham ka't kapbhai' gu noobh gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu chuukug; gio ba' tu'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kɨɨsa' dhi' kiicham gu novɨ gu Kaldeos gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' aajim gu Kaldeos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kiicham jix duñia' gu tai gu vaak bhaan gu Baal gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' daak.

Na gu' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Judaa cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui dɨr gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' daak tu' jix duñia' dhi' kiicham dɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook na ba'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Judaa jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chio'ñ gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' suulh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu vupui; na pai' dhuuk a'gi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook cham na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu innom na ba' duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tai gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Molok; gio ba' cham tu' suudai' u'va dhi' na ba' duñia' jix duñia' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx jano' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel dhi' kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Entregada ka't gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhiogi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Miren tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx oi'ñga'n bɨɨx i'iich bɨɨx jix gɨ'; gio ba' dhi' pai' jix daa.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt na ba' xoi'kam gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan cham gu ñi'ook choo'n gu i'ii'ñ na ba' cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' dhi' gu oidha' tu'r bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨx dhi' jix gɨ' cham bhai' bhaan bɨx xoi'kam gu ñi'ook chɨɨdaim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar dhi' gu oidha' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' oidha' jix gaki cham gu chichio'ñ cham gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr kapbhai' gu noobh gu Kaldeos.

Jano' ba' dɨppɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ jix duu gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Benjamiin gu Jerusalem jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh gɨ' kavɨk jɨ'dɨlh vaak ja'tkam jɨ'dɨlh saagi'ñ; na gu' tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas gookim jix duñia' kua' gu ñi'ook kuupka' naadat kuupa' bham.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' duuñ tu' tu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham ñɨidhat.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu vaak dhi' kiicham gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx.
Na gu' na gu' tɨɨtɨs na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Kaldeos na ba' gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ koko'kam tu' bɨɨx i'iich bɨɨx daak gu vupui dhi' kiicham kuiñcha bɨx; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix tɨ'ɨ; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'r.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Judaa gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Israeel na ja'p gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai' bɨɨx jix duñia' bhaan tu'; gio ba' bɨx uañi'ñ bɨɨx bhaan tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' bhai' ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' naak bɨx xoi'kam tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx xoi'kam bɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' pai' tu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki cham gu chichio'ñ cham gu vaakax jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem cham gu chio'ñ cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n juraa'n gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' na gu' na ba' bɨɨx tas xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhai' ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu oidha' na ja'p gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' dhi' pai' oidha' jix gaki cham gu chio'ñ cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bipia'dam xoi'kam mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh gɨ' kavɨk jɨ'dɨlh vaak ja'tkam jɨ'dɨlh saagi'ñ gu oidha' gu Benjamiin xikoolh gu Jerusalem jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu noobh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu vaak gu Israeel gu vaak gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Pimpollo bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Judaa ka't jix duñia' gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tɨɨt; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu chio'ñ bhaan atooxkor gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu tukaa' cham ka't gu tanoolh tu' gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx tu duukam gu Dabii na ba' mambhɨɨx gu mar gu gɨ'kora' bhaan atooxkor bɨɨx gu Lebitas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p cham jɨ'xdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr tu' oo' gu gɨ' suudai' jɨ'xdha' jix duñia' gu kai' gu Dabii tu duukam gu Lebitas tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' cham baas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gook ja'tkam vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm cham jix xoi'kam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu tanoolh gu tukaa' tu' cham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' gu Jakob gu Dabii tu duukam na ba' cham jix bhɨɨ gu kai' ka't gu Jawatan bhaan gu kai' gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' aapi' gu novɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jerusalem bhaan bɨx jɨ'dɨlh bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' kapbhai' tu' dhi' kiicham gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨɨx gu tai.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook tɨɨda' ka' kuupka' gu novɨ ka' dhagia'; gio ba' gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia tu' tu ñi'ook gu chin gu Babiloonia ba'k.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'; mi' dhɨr cham koi.

Jano' ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ koi jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook tattat gu gɨ'kora' dharka' jix bɨɨx duu va'k tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jerusalem bhaan bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa jix duñia' bhaan gu Lakîs bhaan gu Aseka; na gu' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr gu Sedekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem na ba'.
Na maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam maa'n ja'tkam na tu juan gu ñi'ook; na jix duñia' gu Judiios gu ja'tkam na ja'p tu duukam.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam tɨbiap maa'n tu duukam maa'n ja'tkam na tu juan jix duñia' na ja'p tu duukam.
Gu' gu' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu tu duukam tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx tattat gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv maa'n xibhɨk gu ñi'ook tu' ua'tulhi'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' tu juan namkidhat tu'; gu' tattat cham tu' naak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dua'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui aa'ñdhim maa'n tɨtmo; gio ba' dua'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Gu' gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duñia' maa'n tu duukam maa'n ja'tkam na tu juan dua'ñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim aagak; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu duukam.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' naak maa'n xibhɨk maa'n duiñchu'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhiogi'; jano' ba' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu chichio'ñ bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan cham jix duñia' baabuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan gook tuur bhɨi tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Judaa chiñia' gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tuur.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu chuukug koko'kam ka't na ba' jugi gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa chiñia' kapbhai' gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu novɨ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dhi' kiicham bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tai; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaak gu Rekâbitas tu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' i'i suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' gu Jaasaniias gu mar gu Jeremiiyas gu mar gu abassiniias gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ma'nkam bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu Rekâbitas.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu anaan gu mar gu Igdaliias gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim chiñia' ka't bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Maasiias gu mar gu Sallum jix nukadham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu Rekâbitas jaja' jix bhuup suudai' u'va; gio ba' suudai' u'va.

Gu' gu' gui'p; gio ba' cham i'i suudai' u'va; na gu' gu Jonadab gu mar gu Rekâb chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix aa'ñdhix bham; jano' ba' cham i'i mɨɨjidha' suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tu' gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va tu' gui'x; gu' vaak zel bɨx gu tanoolh na ba' mui'x gu tanoolh bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' pai' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jonadab chulhiiñdha' gu taat gu mar gu Rekâb bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix cham i'i suudai' u'va bɨx taata'n gu tanoolh no'ch tu' taata'n gu u'vɨ tu' taata'n gu ma'nkam tu' taata'n ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu vaak na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' cham mambhɨɨx oidha' u'va tu' gu maa'nkar tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Jonadab chulhiiñdha' gu taat.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem vupui bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos vupui bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siria; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu chio'ñ gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jonadab gu mar gu Rekâb jix aa'ñdhix gu ma'nkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va cham jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu taat; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan a'gi'ñchu' cham jix duñia' naak.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan bɨx tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga; gio ba' jano' maa'n cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt buimɨi cham bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu juan duaka' gu oidha' tu' bhaan tattat; gu' cham naak tu' ja'pni.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Jonadab gu mar gu Rekâb chooto'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix maa gu taat; gu' dhi' gu ja'tkam cham tu'.

Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' bhaan gu Judaa bhaan bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem bɨx cham bhai' bhaan tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu ñi'ook cham; jano' ba' cham jix duñia' tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas ja'tkam vaak gu Rekâbitas; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jonadab gu taat bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' cham gu chio'ñ gu Jonadab gu mar gu Rekâb bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' ka't maakobh oi'ñga' gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uan ua'ñxidha' bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp dɨr gu tanoolh kua'da' dɨr gu tanoolh gu Josiiyas bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Judaa bɨx cham bhai' tu' jix duñia' duñia' na ba' gu ñi'ook maa'n cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Jeremiiyas gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias ua'na gu Baruk gu chin gu Jeremiiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix aa'ñdhix gu Jeremiiyas gu Baruk bham; gio ba' tu' dhi' kuupka' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baakɨi gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ba'k tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu chin gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios maatɨt gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh; gio ba' gio maatɨt bɨx gu Judaa jupaabkamu'n jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm gu Jawatan Dios maa'n cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' jix gɨ' i'iich daak tu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' u'uan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' jixchamaam gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem bɨx gu ja'tkam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu Baruk ñi'ook na tu a'ga u'uan gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Gemariias gu mar gu Sapaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiix ba'k ki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios maatɨt gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Mikêas gu mar gu Gemariias gu mar gu Sapaan dhaibu naak u'uan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chiñia' mi'p maachim; gio ba' gu Elisama gu Delaiias gu mar gu Semeiias gu Elnataan gu mar gu Akbor gu Gemariias gu mar gu Sapaan gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Ananiias bɨx chiñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mikêas bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't naak gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' gu Baruk u'uan maatɨt gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mɨjɨ bɨx chiñia' gu Jeudii gu mar gu Netaniias gu mar gu Selemiias gu mar gu Kusi na ba' tu ñi'ook gu Baruk; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maatɨt gu ja'tkam jix ai; mi' dhɨr gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' xanoop jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak maatɨt; mi' dhɨr ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Baruk maatɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook maa'n duiñchu' gui'p gu Baruk; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨkka gu Baruk bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook gu chin gu Jeremiiyas bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Baruk; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu chin bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx u'uan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p chiñia' gu Baruk; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jeremiiyas soo'mchulhdhak duukat.
Jano' ba' baap gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhaibu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Elisama; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu gɨ'kora' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeudii jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Elisama ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jeudii maatɨt gu gɨ'kora' maatɨt bɨx chiñia' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ'kora' mi'p.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu Jeudii ka't jiñkai'ñ vaik maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu tai ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm bɨx bhaan gu tai gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' cham chooto'n choo'n tu' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Elnataan gu Delaiias gu Gemariias gu gɨ'kora' cham gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr cham.

Jano' ba' va'k jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerameel gu mar gu Amelek gu Seraiias gu mar gu Asriel gu Selemiias gu mar gu Abdeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baruk gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Baruk ka't ua'nak gu chin gu Jeremiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ ua'ñxidha' bɨx gu ñi'ook tumiiñku mi'p maa'n gu ñi'ook gu Joakim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' daipu' gu Joakim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tɨɨda' ɨlhdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook dhi' gu oidha' cham gu chichio'ñ tu' gu vaakax.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Joakim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' cham bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug ka't baas jix tónom gu tanoolh gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu kai' bhaan tu duukam tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem bhaan gu chio'ñ gu Judaa bɨx cham bhai' tu ñi'ook cham.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jeremiiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias; gio ba' ua'na gu chin gu Jeremiiyas bɨx gu ñi'ook u'uan gu ñi'ook gu tai gu Joakim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu bhaan mumua'da' gu ñi'ook tuutu'm.

Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Josiiyas pai' gu Koniias gu mar gu Joakim gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu duukam tu' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jeremiiyas.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu Jukal gu mar gu Selemiias gu Sepaniias gu mar gu Maasiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' tu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam busaak tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu vaak kuupa'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Faraoon ka't gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto suudai' u'va gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n maatɨt gu Kaldeos ko'kmarak mia'n gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bhañ tu' na ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Faraoon ka't gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kaldeos dhi' kiicham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tai.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bham; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' gu Kaldeos jix duñia' no'ch; na gu' cham.
Na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ maa'n jix búup vaak zel jix duñia' dhi' kiicham gu tai.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos ka't gu Jerusalem kuiñcha ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Faraoon.
Jano' ba' busaak gu Jerusalem gu Jeremiiyas na ba' jix duu gu oidha' gu Benjamiin na ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Iriias gu mar gu Selemiias gu mar gu ananiias gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' tu' gu Kaldeos.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' ɨɨxi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kaldeos; gu' cham va'k gu Iriias gu Jeremiiyas vupui bhaan chiñia'.
Na gu' chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jeremiiyas jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jonataan na gu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak kuupa'.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu Jeremiiyas gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' dhaibu dhi' gu Jeremiiyas mui'x gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas bhañ jix buusñi; gio ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'; jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka' dhagia'.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Jeremiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' bhaan tu duukam bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu vaak kuupa'.
Jano' ba' duukat jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' bham; gio ba' cham ɨlhdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan; na gu' jix duñia' jano' ñi'ook Jawatan vupui bhaan tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jonataan na gu' cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu Jeremiiyas naadat kuupa' gu takarui' gu tanoolh ɨrban gu Panaderos bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu takarui' kiicham; gio ba' gu Jeremiiyas naadat kuupa'.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Sepatiias gu mar gu Mataan gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Pasur gu Jukal gu mar gu Selemiias gu Pasur gu mar gu Melkîas gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas ua'rgidhimɨk bɨx gu ja'tkam bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kiicham koi bhiogi' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Kaldeos ii'mdagaram gu oidha' ka't ii'mdagaram.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tɨɨda' ka't kapbhai' dhi' kiicham gu novɨ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gui'p chiñia' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' dhi' gu chio'ñ; na gu' dhi' gu noobh gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' dhi' kiicham gu noobh bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; na gu' dhi' gu chio'ñ cham tu jiim bhai'x i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh; na gu gɨ'kora' cham bhaan cham tu'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jeremiiyas tu' jix duu jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Malkîas gu mar gu Amelek ka't naadat kuupa'; gio ba' gu Jeremiiyas bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr cham ka't gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu jiim gu Jeremiiyas.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Ebed-melek gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' jix daa gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas kua' daakat gu gɨ'kora' ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ebed-melek jix buus gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' bham.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' cham bhai' jix duu dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ bɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' koi bhiogi' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu takarui' kiicham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu Ebed-melek gu Etiope bham; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu vupui gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan va'k.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Ebed-melek gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ chɨbiapui gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' pai' bɨtaa'n jix bhɨɨ kɨklhi'ñga'n gu Jeremiiyas bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ebed-melek gu Etiope gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' jix dhaas jano' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨklhi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu Jeremiiyas.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeremiiyas bɨɨx jix tɨ'ɨ; gio ba' gu Jeremiiyas naadat kuupa'.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ba'k ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeremiiyas; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham matgɨm.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas gu Sedekîas; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'r koo'nda' tu' cham.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas ɨxchuixim gu Jeremiiyas bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu dhi' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' kooda' tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas gu Sedekîas; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu i'ii'ñ ii'mdagaram dhi' kiicham cham ka't jix duñia' gu tai; jano' ba' ii'mdagaram tu' gu vaak.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia dhi' kiicham ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Kaldeos jix duñia' gu tai tu' cham gu noobh.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu Judiios jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu Kaldeos cham kapbhai' gu noobh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' cham tu' kapbhai'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' chɨɨdaim gu ñi'ook ii'mdagaram gu i'ii'ñ.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't jix buusñi chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu Te jix duñia' bhaan tu'; jano' ba' tɨɨt suulh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam gu Kaldeos tu' cham gu noobh gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka' kuupka' dhi' kiicham gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sedekîas gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook cham koi.
Jano' ba' tu' chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook bɨndak tu'; gio ba' jano' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' cham tu' kooda'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' daipu'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' cham gu vaak gu Jonataan na gu' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨx chiñia' gu Jeremiiyas tɨkka; gio ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix duñia'; na gu' bɨɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' cham ka't naak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeremiiyas naadat kuupa' bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh ka't gu Jerusalem; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jerusalem ka't.

Jano' ba' jix bhai'x oi'ñga' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' gu Sedekîas maakobh gu ñi'ook ka't kiicham.

Jano' ba' baap bɨx chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Nergal-sareser gu Samgar-nebo gu Sarsekim gu Rabsaris gu Nergal-sareser gu Rabmag bɨx chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jiboi'ññor moor gu tukaa' kiicham gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' ki'ñgob tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook vaak jodai; gio ba' jix buus gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki.

Gu' gu' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos chɨ'ɨɨk jix duñia' gu Sedekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerikoo; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ tu' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Ribla gu oidha' gu amat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu ma'nkam gu Sedekîas gu Ribla gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx na ba' jix duñia' gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu Kaldeos jix dhaas gu tai gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu ja'tkam jix duñia' vaak jodai gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' kiicham jix bhai'x bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' bhaan gu Babiloonia gu Nabusaradaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham gu ñi'ook gu Nabusaradaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Judaa bia' cham ko'kmarak cham tu' jix maa jano' ba' oidha' u'va dɨppɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Nabukodonosor ka't jix duñia' gu Nabusaradaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham cham bhai'; gio ba' va'k jix duu bɨɨx na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nabusaradaan gu Nabusasbaan gu Rabsaris gu Nergal-sareser gu Rabmag bɨx chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Jeremiiyas naadat kuupa' kapbhai' gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan na ba' jix buusñi gu vaak; gio ba' jix oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas kua' kuupka' naadat kuupa' bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Ebed-melek gu Etiope bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Miren gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan dhi' kiicham na ba' cham bhai' cham na ba' xoi'kam; jano' ba' aajim mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Gu' gu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham ka' dhagia' gu novɨ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook gu oidha' tu' ka't na gu' chotdonɨt tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr gu Nabusaradaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ dɨr gu Ramaa na pai' dhuuk jix bhɨɨ kua' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu Jerusalem gu Judaa jix duñia' gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook dhi' cham bhai' bhaan dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ka't tu ñi'ook; na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios cham ja'pni gu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap dhi'.

Jano' ba' jano' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu noobh; gio ba' tu' xoi'kam jix ai gu Babiloonia jix ai tu'; gu' tu' cham tu' xoi'kam jix ai gu Babiloonia; jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' tu' pai' tutkɨ gu ñi'ook tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't na pai' dhuuk; gio ba' gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa jix duñia' bɨɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' pai' tu' gu ñi'ook tu'; jano' ba' jix maa juana'.
Jano' ba' ka't jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu Mispa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chiñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't yooxi' gu chichio'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't gu ñi'ook gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam bhaan gu oidha' ka't gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh bia' gu oidha' cham jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Gedaliias gu Mispa maachim gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu Joanaan gu Jonataan gu ma'nkam gu Karea gu Seraiias gu mar gu Tanumet gu ma'nkam gu Epi gu Netopatita gu Jesaniias gu mar gu Maakâti gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan gu chichio'ñ bham; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n tu juan gu Kaldeos; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gui'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Mispa na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Kaldeos aajim no'ch; gu' suudai' u'va gu takarui' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu i'ii'ñ jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Judiios mi'p gu Moab tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Edom mi'p bɨx oi'ñga'n na pai' dhuuk na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim dhɨt gu Judea ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu Judiios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' bɨx jix duñia' tɨɨtɨs gu oidha' gu Judaa gu Gedaliias gu Mispa; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu bhóogɨt mui'x gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mi'p yooxi' tɨɨtɨs gu Gedaliias gu Mispa.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' cham ñɨidhat tɨɨda' na ja'p gu Baalis gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias na ba' kooda' gu' gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam cham gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea gu Gedaliias ɨxchuixim gu Mispa bham; gio ba' tu' tu jiim jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu chio'ñ cham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' kooda' bɨx gu Judiios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' na gu' ɨɨxi'ñdha' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Ismael.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv suudai' u'va gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu mar gu Elisama gu kai' vaak ja'tkam dhɨt chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu Mispa; gio ba' koi'mɨk gu takarui' tɨtda:―Aañ gu Mispa.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx mi'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan mii' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naaka'n gu Ismael bɨx gu Judiios mi'p bɨɨx gu Gedaliias gu Mispa sandaarui'x gu Kaldeos gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr gu Gedaliias na pai' dhuuk soo'mchulhdhak bhai'x.
Na aajidha' gu chichio'ñ gu Sikêm gu Silo gu Samaria jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh gu maa'nkar na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Mispa jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam joi'ndam gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias; gio ba' ka't na ja'p jix duñia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx mi'p.

Gu' gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu bakia' mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gui'p gu Ismael; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tañia' yooxi' gu ñi'ook kai' vaas bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Ismael bɨx gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ naaka'n kuiñcha gu Gedaliias ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa kuiñcha gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix bhuup koko'kam gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Ismael gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu Mispa; gio ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Mispa ka't jix duñia' ka't gu Nabusaradaan gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias ka't na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mi'p bɨɨx bɨx cham bhai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu Aguas-mukas gu Gabaoon.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx gu Ismael jix ñi' gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mi'p bɨɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Ismael ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mispa suulh jix bɨɨx duu gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea.
Gu' gu' gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Joanaan bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ ka't gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx mi'p jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu Mispa mi' dhɨr naaka'n gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu Joanaan ka't gu ñi'ook gu Gabaoon.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix daa gu Gerut-kimam mia'n gu Betleem gu ñi'ook jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu Kaldeos; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Ismael gu mar gu Netaniias gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea gu Jesaniias gu mar gu Osaiia bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' chulhiiñdha' soi'ñ vupui bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook no'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' jix duñia' mui'x na ja'p gu vupui.
Na ba' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt pai' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' tu' naak; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' ka't bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch ñi'ookdham tu'r gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham jurtu'nka' bɨx mii' dhɨr na ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix bhai' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu'; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx mi'p bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu oidha' cham; gio ba' gu ux na tu ibai' cham; na gu' dhi' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia namki' choo'n; na gu' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' tu' na ba' dodhia' jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bham; gio ba' cham va'k ba'k gu oidha' gu Ejipto cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham tu' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk tu' bhiogi' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Judaa; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu vupui na ba' baakɨi gu Ejipto ba'k na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Ejipto bhiogi' namki' choo'n gu Ejipto; gio ba' koi.
Jano' ba' ka't bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui na ba' baakɨi gu Ejipto na ba' gu ñi'ook bhiogi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' vupui bhaan cham bhai' tu' bhaan.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk na ja'p ja'aa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem daak bhaan gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk ba'k gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr boopoya' gu ñi'ook mu'ai; jano' ba' cham chɨgia' dhi' pai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa; gio ba' cham gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' aa'ñdham gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook maachim tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨx tu'x bhañ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨda' bhiogi' gu ñi'ook koi pai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim baakɨi na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu Jeremiiyas jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't.

Ba' jix aa' gu Asariias gu mar gu Osaiias gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' a'ga; jano' ba' cham gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias tu' jix duñia' bhaan no'ch na ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Kaldeos na ba' kooda' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' va'k jix bhɨɨ gu Joanaan gu mar gu Karea bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx gu Judaa bɨx chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Nabusaradaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Gedaliias gu mar gu Aikam gu mar gu Sapaan gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias.
Jano' ba' baap gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu Tapnes.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas gu Tapnes bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨɨx gu novɨ gu jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhi'ñ ki'ñgob gu vaak gu Faraoon gu Tapnes ñiata gu chichio'ñ gu Judiios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Miren tu' jootsa' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia tu duukam atooxkor bhaan dhi' gu jodai gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na koi'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr kutun gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ja'p bipia'dam jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' dhi' gu Bet-semes gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Judiios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Migdol gu Tapnes gu Nop gu oidha' gu Patros bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' buupui bɨx cham bhai' bhaan gu Jerusalem bhaan bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' kuiñcha tu' na cham jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jiimchu' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tattat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan bɨx tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' cham jano' dhi' tu'.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naak na ba' tu' na cham jir bhai' na ba' cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ja'aa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu Jerusalem chajaañ na ja'p gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' cham bhai' bhaan gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judaa cham jix duñia' oi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx buimɨi gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook mu'ai gu ñi'ook bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' na cham jir bhai' tattat tu' na cham jir bhai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa tu' na cham jir bhai' gu u'vɨ tu' na cham jir bhai' gu u'vɨ jix duu gu oidha' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' choo'n tu' jix duñia' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' ñi'ook kavɨk vupui bhaan tattat.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Miren tu' jix duñia' gu vupui gu ñi'ook na ba' cham bhai' na ba' cham tu' duu bɨx gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa jix dhaas gu vupui na ba' baakɨi gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto ka't bɨx ka't bhiogi' gu ñi'ook dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook mu'ai.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ja'p gu Jerusalem bɨɨx bhiogi' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa baap gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Judaa gu ñi'ook na ba' jix daa; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ jix daa gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu u'vɨ mi'p bɨx gu ja'tkam jix daa gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Patros tu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.

Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin na ba' gu tɨkɨr gu vaak na jix bhai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook no'ch gu chin tattat gu chin gu gɨ'kora' gu chin chiñia' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu takarui' cham cham bhai' oi'ñdha'.
Gu' gu' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' uañi'ñ bɨx bhiogi' gu'ch.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook na ba' bopxi'ñ gu vaak na jix bhai' cham gu chio'ñ bɨpna'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu ñi'ook dhi' bham.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tɨbiap chɨ'ñchoka' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu Jerusalem tattat gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios kuiñcha gu ñi'ook buimɨi kuiñcha dua'ñ gu ñi'ook; na ba' gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook mu'ai bɨɨx ka'm cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' ñi'ook kavɨk tu'; na ba' tu' tɨbiap bhaan dhi' cham bhai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu Judaa gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ bɨɨx gu chin bɨɨx gu noobh bham; mi' dhɨr gu Kumpliremos gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai'; jano' ba' tu'r tu duukam.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu Judaa gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu Miren gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' cham ka't bɨx gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu chin gu chio'ñ gu Judiio bham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' bhaan na ba' cham bhai' cham na ba' xoi'kam; gio ba' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa gu oidha' gu Ejipto ka't bhiogi' bɨɨx ka'm bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Judaa gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu Judaa jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook chɨkka tu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gui'x gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' dhiñ tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook na ba' cham bhai' bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kapbhai' gu Faraoon gu opra gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p kapbhai' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaamki'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uan dhi' gu ñi'ook gu chin gu Jeremiiyas oi'ñga' maakobh gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' gu ñi'ook gu Baruk.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' jano' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdha' bhaan; mi' dhɨr cham gaagam.
