Jano' ba' a'ga; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ux vaas na mi' oi'ñga'n bɨx dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; na gu' tu' cham bhai' bhaan bɨx gu chuukug tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oidha' bɨx pai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bhaan chɨbɨɨp.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto; gio ba' bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Faraoon gu Nekâo gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto ka't mia'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates gu Karkêmis naaka'n gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia oi'ñga' maakobh gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo jix duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' jix duñia' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jix bɨɨx duu jiboi'ññor cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x tu' jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ju'ñdharan gu Euprates gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ia'rɨ.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gɨ' suudai' jiim jix duñia' gu suudai' oidha' bhaan jiim na ja'p.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ejipto na ja'p gɨ' suudai' jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' oidha' bhaan jiim na ja'p; gio ba' gu oidha' kiicham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Kus gu Put gu ñi'ook gu Lut gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh ka't gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tanoolh na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kuchii gu ɨ'ɨr; na gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu oidha' ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Galaad jix bhɨɨ gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook na ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu oidha'; na gu' jix kavɨk bɨɨx jix kavɨk ia'rɨ jix duñia' tɨtda:―Aañ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook namkia' gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto maachim gu Migdol; gio ba' maachim gio gu Nop gu Tapnes; mi' dhɨr ja'xñi; jano' ba' na ba'; na gu' gu kuchii tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk cham mambhɨɨx na gu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix mui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n bhaan duiñchu' gui'p; gio ba' gu Lebaantate chulhiiñdha' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ na ja'p gu Tabor tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakkavɨk na ja'p gu Karmelo gu gɨ' suudai' ɨlhdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu Ejipto; na gu' gu Nop ka't gu ñi'ook ka't bɨɨx ka'm cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto; gu' jupaabkamu'n chajaañ jupaabkamu'n.
Jano' ba' sandaarui'x gio tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; na gio suulh jiboi'ññor bɨx cham; na gu' suudai' u'va bhaan gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ko'oi; na gu' bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham aajim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n na ja'p gu u'u.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham; na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Ejipto; gio ba' kapbhai' ka't gu novɨ gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam gu Amoon cham gu Faraoon gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu Faraoon na ja'p jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu novɨ tu duukam; gu' mi' dhɨr ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' cham jum i'obh tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob cham gu Israeel; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu kai' gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jakob ka't cham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob cham jum i'obh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak; na gu' bɨx chɨbɨɨp tu' baas; gu' tu' cham bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai' cham tu' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Palestinos va'k gu Faraoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gasa.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' bhi'ñbak tu' gu oidha' jɨ'dɨlh gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu chichio'ñ tu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk gu jodai' na jix uam tattat cham gu ma'nkam gu noobh.

Jano' ba' kuiñcha gu tanoolh jupaabkamu'n na ba' chajaañ bɨx gu Palestinos na ba' jix duñia' gu Tiro gu Sidoon bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Palestinos gu Kaptor.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu Gasa suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Askaloon ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham jix duñia' gu Meetete gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Askaloon gu gɨ' suudai' jix dhaas.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moab; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Nebo ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; jano' ba' ka't; gio ba' ka't gu Misgab.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Moab; gio ba' bhaan gu esboon cham bhai' bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp; jano' ba' gio tu' gu Madmeen ka' gu kuchii bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu oronaim chajaañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Moab ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duu tu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Luit bɨɨx suanda' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux na tu ibai'; na gu' gu oronaim gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dodhia' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gio ka'; gio ba' gu Kêmos jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan chiñia' bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh matgɨm kiicham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio gu ñi'ook ka't vaak ja'tkam na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gɨ' vaak ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab na ba'; na gu' ka't oidha' jix gaki jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx ka'm cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juruuñ gu Moab dɨr bhaan tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook cham ka't bhaan vaaso tu' cham pai' dhuuk ka't; na ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhaan jix duu bhaan; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Moab gu Kêmos gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el chotdonɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu'ch jix kavɨk gu chichio'ñ na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Moab jɨ'dɨlh biipibop jix dhaav tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' mia'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab na ba' jix ai cham bhai' jix jai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' bɨx gu tɨɨgɨ' ja'xñi; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' xanoop jix gaki mar u'vɨ gu Diboon; na gu' gu Moab jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Aroer; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Moab na gu' ka't jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duuñ; mi' dhɨr gu Arnoon gu Moab.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va ñi'ook na jir bhai' bhaan gu oidha' vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' bhaan gu oloon bhaan gu Jasa bhaan gu Mepaat.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu Diboon bhaan gu Nebo bhaan gu Bet-diblataim.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu Kîriataim bhaan gu Bet-gamul bhaan gu Bet-meon.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu Kêriot bhaan gu Bosra bhaan bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' gu Moab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mia'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Moab bhaan ka't gio.
Na gu' cham tu' ka't tu' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨ'xkum na gu' dɨr tu ñi'ook tu' joi'mdak.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Moab; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gioda' gu ñi'ook gu chin gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Moab gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' kakasnira' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' cham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu Moab bhaan bɨx gu Moab tu ñi'ook bhaan gu chichio'ñ gu Kir-eres.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx suanda' gu Jaser gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Sibma; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Jaser; mi' dhɨr bhaan suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook xoi'kam vaak ja'tkam gu oidha' gu Moab; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' bɨɨx; jano' ba' cham ka't.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook dɨr gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm gu Eleale; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jaas jix maa gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dɨr gu Soar bɨɨx ka'm gu oronaim gu ñi'ook vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gio gu suudai' gu Nimrin ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p kuiñcha gu Moab gu i'ii'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu Kir-eres; na gu' jix koi namkɨm ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx mo'o gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ka't; gio ba' bhaan bɨx gu noobh bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' gu Moab na ja'p vaaso cham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Moab ka't gu ñi'ook ka't gu Moab gu ñi'ook bɨx xikoolh.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix duñia' gu Moab.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu i'ii'ñ jix kavɨk gu Moab na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu u'vɨ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Moab ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ja'tkam; na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Moab tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhi'ñ; gio ba' ka't kuupka' jix duñia'; na gu' tu' bhaan gu Moab oi'ñga' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ɨkgiga'n gu esboon gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk; gu' jix buus gu tai gu esboon mɨmɨim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu Moab gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Moab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Kêmos; na gu' gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu ui'ka' na ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab kuugalhdha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Moab.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham juraa'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham juraa'n bi'ya' gu Por gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu gɨ'kora' gu Gad gu ja'tkam jix daa jɨ'dɨlh.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Rabba gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' gɨ' kavɨk jɨ'dɨlh ka't gu tai tu' gu Israeel gu maa'nkar tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu esboon na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ai; na gu' duuñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Rabba jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan oidha' bhai' na gu' gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan chiñia' bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka ɨlhdham bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' boopoya' u'u kavɨk maa'n gu vupui cham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Edom; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matda' gu Temaan tu' mamatdagɨm matda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maat na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Dedaan; na gu' gu Esauu bhaan gu ñi'ook no'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' cham tu' ɨ'xkum gu tukaa'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esauu cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu kai' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr cham ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' dɨ'dɨlhdhɨm.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham mi'p i'i gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka' tu' bɨx cham ka' gu ñi'ook tɨɨda' i'i.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook mu'ai ka't gu Bosra; gio ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mattuda' chɨbɨɨp bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan jix búup.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ali' tu' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu jodai' na jix uam jix duñia' gu kavɨk; gio ba' na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook tu' jix dhaav tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Edom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr jix duñia' bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' na ja'p bhaan gu Sodoma gu Gomorra jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook soo'mchulhdhak tu' jix daa gu mar gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p maavɨt jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jordaan bhaan; na gu' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan ua'tulhi'ñ; na gu' chɨkka nɨidhim tu' chɨkka ka't mii' dhɨr bipia'dam.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhaan gu Edom; gio ba' tu' bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Temaan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jix kai gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix tɨ'ɨ jix duñia' bhaan gu Bosra; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix kavɨk gu Edom ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gu u'vɨ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Damasko; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu amat gu Arpad na gu'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' cham jɨ'xdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Damasko na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'; gio ba' na ja'p gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham bhai' ñi'ook kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam biipibop bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu tai vaak jodai gu Damasko gu vaak gu Ben-adad.

Jano' ba' gu Kedar oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu asor naaka'n gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Kedar gu ma'nkam tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' vaak zel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix ai jix bhɨɨ na ba'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨt bhaan ɨɨbhi'ñ xikoolh.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu asor tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix bhɨɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' namki' kiki'ñgob tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't jix ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx jɨbɨɨlh bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu asor ka't gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' tu' jix daa gu mar gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Elam bɨɨpɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Elam bɨɨpɨ' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Elam maakobh jɨbɨɨlh maakobh gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jɨbɨɨlh; gio ba' tu' gu ja'tkam cham gu Elam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Elam vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' bhaan cham bhai' i'iich tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu kuchii bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Elam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuugalhdha' gu tanoolh gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Elam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Babiloonia bhaan gu oidha' gu Kaldeos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp maachim; gio ba' gio gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham; jano' ba' ja'xñi; gio ba' gu Babiloonia gu Bel gu Merodak; mi' dhɨr duiñxim.
Na gu' na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' cham tu' gu chio'ñ tu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios aajim gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bɨɨma'n; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiim joi'ndam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Sioon bhaan pai' gu vupui bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan mɨɨjidha' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' kakneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bipia'dam jix duu gu kakkavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu kavɨk gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' am:―Ja'pji gu ñi'ook; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios nɨɨra tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Babiloonia gu oidha' gu Kaldeos gu ñi'ook na ja'p vupui bhaan gu vaakax.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu Babiloonia gu masad gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; gio ba' dɨr bhaan ka't; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jix kavɨk cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Kaldea ka't na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar na gu' na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu naan gu ñi'ook jix jai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix mar; gio ba' ka't chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu ñi'ook ka't bɨx; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Babiloonia jix duñia' bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Babiloonia xikoolh bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhaan cham; na gu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' jix maa gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak jodai; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx na ja'p jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Babiloonia juraa'n gu ñi'ook oraa'; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu kuchii maa'n jix maat gu vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam maa'n bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria maa'n; jano' ba' dhi' gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia kuugalhdha'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu oidha' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Karmelo gu Basaan; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu Galaad gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Israeel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu Judaa cham gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' bhɨɨya' tɨtda:―Cha'pim.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu oidha' gu Merataim bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Pekod; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui jurtu'nka' bɨx tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu oidha' jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia oidha' jix gaki tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia tu' cham; na gu' bakia' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix kupi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chumñigam jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich; na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu oidha' gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'; jano' ba' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨbiap gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Babiloonia na ba' gu Sioon gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Babiloonia bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' yooxi' bhaan xikoolh; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx jix duu bɨɨx; na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam biipibop bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' gu tanoolh tɨbiap gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tai jɨ'dɨlh gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx xikoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bɨɨma'n; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' kuiñcha na ba' gu oidha' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Kaldeos tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Babiloonia bhaan chiñia' bhaan mamatdagɨm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' bhaan jix kavɨk ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan kavaayo bhaan bɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't na ja'p gu u'vɨ; gio ba' bhaan ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu suudai'; na gu' gu oidha' duiñxim.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu vaakax gu kakkavɨk bɨɨx sɨsɨɨ' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gio gu u'uuv; gio ba' cham ka't na ba' bɨɨx tas tu' jix daa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Sodoma gu Gomorra jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ jix daa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' mui'x gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook u'u kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't cham jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu mar na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai' gɨ' kavɨk bhaan kavaayo; jano' ba' jix duñia' na ja'p gu chio'ñ bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ na ja'p gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p maavɨt jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jordaan gu vaak na jix bhai' jix kavɨk; na gu' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan ua'tulhi'ñ; na gu' chɨkka nɨidhim tu' chɨkka ka't mii' dhɨr bipia'dam.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhaan gu Babiloonia tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' gu Kaldeos; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook jix kai tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu Babiloonia bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n bhaan tu' gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; na gu' ka't bhaan gu tanoolh cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' cham biipibop bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koko'kam gu oidha' gu Kaldeos gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu Israeel gu Judaa cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu oidha' ka't jix bhuup uañi'ñ bhaan jix bhaan gu Israeel.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Babiloonia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu i'ii'ñ na gu' cham kuiñcha tu' na cham jir bhai'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu Baso jix uam jodai ka't gu Babiloonia gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' suudai' u'va i'i chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Babiloonia; gio ba' bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu ux na tu ibai' na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Babiloonia cham tu'; gio ba' tɨtda:―Cha'pim maa'n gu oidha'; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx ka'm tɨbaa'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu tasi' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kutun kavɨk; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Media; na gu' bhaan gu Babiloonia na ba' cham tu' duu; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan vaak jodai gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Babiloonia.
Na gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ mumua'da' gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbiap tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bham; gio ba' tu' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu ñi'ook bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oidha' bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oipichu' bɨɨx matda' gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx.
Na jix maa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ tɨbaa'ñ kuugalhdha' gu oidha'; gio ba' duñia' bɨɨx dhuuk jix buusñi gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; na gu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨx na gu' gu ñi'ook cham juraa'n gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi.
Jano' ba' cham na ja'p baasɨ'n gu Jakob; na gu' gu Pormador bɨx; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' chɨbɨɨp tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ kavaayo tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' kɨklhi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ biipibop.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bipia'dam; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ uubas; mi' dhɨr chiñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' namkidha' gu Babiloonia bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Kaldea bɨx cham bhai' jix duu gu Sioon vupui bhaan gu vupui tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Miren tu' bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu novɨ bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam tu' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' soo'mchulhdhak jix bhɨɨ tu' gu jodai na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' ka' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam chɨbɨɨp bhaan; gio ba' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Ararat gu Minni gu Askênas; mi' dhɨr nɨi'ñchudat bhaan jix tɨ'ɨ kavaayo na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Media bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu oidha' aapi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; na gu' tu jiim bhaan gu Babiloonia bɨx gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix dhaas gu oidha' gu Babiloonia cham ka't gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix kavɨk gu Babiloonia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk; gio ba' gu kavɨk na ja'p gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu vaak jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mattuda' bɨɨx mattuda' na ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu gu tai gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' mar u'vɨ gu Babiloonia na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'; jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu ñi'ook oraa'.
Jano' ba' jix jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' jix duñia' na ja'p vaaso cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tɨrook vook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu chuukug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Kaldea gu Jerusalem.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' kuiñcha; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Babiloonia na ba' gɨ' kavɨk gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p.
Jano' ba' jix tónom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p ali' karneer na ja'p gu chuukug bɨɨx chiiw.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sesak ka't bɨx gu oidha' gu Koomo ka't gu Babiloonia gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan gu Babiloonia; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't iiñat.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix gaki oidha' jix gaki pai' cham soo'mchulhdhak tu' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bel gu Babiloonia jix buusñi gu chin tu'; gio ba' cham aajim chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr vaak jodai gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu Salid tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dodhia' maa'n gu oidha' gu ñi'ook i'iich gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ ɨɨbhi'ñdha' kuiñcha gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu oidha' oi'ñga' ɨlhdham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n mi' dhɨr oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bhaan.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu' gu Babiloonia bɨx gu oidha' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨx koko'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai' ñi'ook bhaan gu Babiloonia; na gu' aajim bhaan tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu Babiloonia ka't kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koko'kam gu Israeel gio gu Babiloonia koko'kam bɨx gu oidha'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' mui'x gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.
Na gu' dhi' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu jodai' na jix uam jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui na gu' tɨɨtɨs bhaan vaak na jix bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Babiloonia gu tɨkɨr tu' jix bhai'x gu kavɨk tu' aajim tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia jix gɨ' gu oidha' gu Kaldeos.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Babiloonia jix jai'; gio ba' na ja'p mumua'da' gu suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Babiloonia jix kavɨk jix bɨɨx duu ui'ka' gu ñi'ook ka't; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' mamatdagɨm gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk; gio ba' koox cham jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' vaak jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Babiloonia ka't jix duñia' kiki'ñgob ka't gu tai; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ja'tkam chɨbɨɨp gu tai jix duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook bhañ gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Seraiias gu mar gu Neriias gu mar gu Maasiias na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Babiloonia maakobh oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ka't gu Seraiias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu Jeremiiyas u'uan bɨx cham bhai' ka't jix ai bhaan gu Babiloonia bɨx gu ñi'ook ua'ñix bhaan gu Babiloonia.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas gu Seraiias; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Babiloonia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' bɨx dhi' tu'x.

Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan dhi' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm cham gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n tu' gu chio'ñ tu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' u'uan gu jodai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Babiloonia cham jix búup cham bhai' tu' bhaan; mi' dhɨr ka't; jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Sedekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu naan gu amutal mar u'vɨ gu Jeremiiyas gu Libna.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Joakim.
Jano' ba' kuiñcha daak gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Jerusalem gu Judaa ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sedekîas bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh suudai' u'va gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Jerusalem bhaan yooxi' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' juruuñ mia'n kiicham bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh gu ñi'ook bhiogi' kiicham bɨɨx ka'm cham gu takarui' na ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' ka't ba'k kiicham bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jiboi'ññor moor kiicham gu tukaa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook vaak jodai ka't mia'n u'uu pai' gu gɨ'kora' jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki kua' gu Kaldeos ju'ñdharan kiicham xikoolh.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos chɨ'ɨɨk gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Sedekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerikoo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Ribla gu oidha' gu amat pai' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu ma'nkam gu Sedekîas vupui bhaan gu vupui gio bɨx chiñia' gu Judaa gu Ribla.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Sedekîas cham gu ñi'ook jix buusñi gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; gio ba' jix dhaas gu vaak kuupa' bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh jix koi.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam mambhɨɨx ka't oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem gu Nabusaradaan gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu vaak gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu tai bɨx jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx vaak jodai gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu bhaan gu Nabusaradaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bia' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ja'tkam kiicham jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨx.
Gu' gu' bia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nabusaradaan na ba' oidha' u'va uubas.

Jano' ba' gu Kaldeos jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨgɨ jodai mi'p gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ' suudai' jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨk bɨx gu jodai' na jix uam gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jaja' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daa'nkar tai na jix tas kutun kavɨk; gio ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu vaakax jix vɨgɨ jodai mi'p bɨtaa'n ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' jix duu gu jodai' na jix uam bɨx dhi' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' ka't maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't bhaan ka't gu ñi'ook jixchamaam bɨɨx jix vɨgɨ xikoolh bɨx jix vɨgɨ jodai; gio ba' ka't gookim bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx jix duñia' chamaam bhaan jix vɨgɨ xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seraiias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Soponiias gook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan vaik nuuka'n.

Jano' ba' kiicham jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhaan gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham kɨɨv gu chichio'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook kiicham; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu oidha' na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook kiicham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Nabusaradaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu Ribla.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia naaka'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ribla gu oidha' gu amat; gio ba' ka't gu Judaa bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Nabukodonosor bhaan; gio ba' oi'ñga' kɨɨv vaik jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judiios.
Jano' ba' jix duu oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nabukodonosor bhaan gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook gook.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nabukodonosor bhaan gu Nabusaradaan oo'm jixchamaam gu Judiios; gio ba' bɨx jix bɨɨx duu maakobh jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Joakîn gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu ñi'ook gu Ebil-merodak gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia oi'ñga' maa'n gu gɨ'kora' mo'o gu Joakîn gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix buusñi gu vaak kuupa'.
Ba' jix aa' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu bhaan a'toxkar gu gɨ'kora' mi'p bɨɨx gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' vupui bhaan bɨɨx tas bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu tanoolh bɨx gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm.
